title_en: Taizhou People's Procuratorate of Jiangsu Province v. Wang Guiping — case of endangering public safety by dangerous means, selling counterfeit and substandard products, and falsely reporting registered capital
ruling_gist_en: Where an actor knowingly foresees that harm to others' health will occur, but allows such result to happen out of the purpose of illegal profit, by selling counterfeit pharmaceutical excipients to drug manufacturers for use in drug production, causing serious consequences of severe injury or death after the drugs are put on the market, the act constitutes the crime of endangering public safety by dangerous means.
keywords_en: criminal; endangering public safety by dangerous means; selling counterfeit or substandard products; false declaration of registered capital; first instance; intermediate people's court; Jiangsu Province; Heilongjiang Province; Guangdong Province; natural person; criminal law; constitutive elements of the crime of endangering public safety by dangerous means; subjective intent of passing off diethylene glycol as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol; combined punishment for multiple crimes; selling counterfeit pharmaceutical excipients; passing off diethylene glycol as propylene glycol; drugs causing death
full_text_en:
Procuratorial Authority of Taizhou City, Jiangsu Province v. Wang Guiping — case concerning endangering public security by dangerous means, selling fake and shoddy products, and falsely reporting registered capital

【Ruling Summary】

Where an actor knows that his conduct will cause harm to others' health, but for the purpose of illegal profit, allows such consequences to occur, and sells counterfeit pharmaceutical excipients to a drug manufacturer for the production of drugs, resulting in serious consequences of death or serious injury to patients after the drugs are put on the market, his conduct constitutes the crime of endangering public security by dangerous means.

Procuratorial Authority: Procuratorial Authority of Taizhou City, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant: Wang Guiping, male, 42 years old, Han ethnicity, former legal representative of Jiangsu Meiqi Fine Chemical Co., Ltd., residing in Qiansan Group, Shimixiang Qianqian, Heshi Town, Taixing City. Arrested on June 6, 2006.

The Procuratorial Authority of Taizhou City, Jiangsu Province, filed a public prosecution with the Intermediate People's Court of Taizhou City, Jiangsu Province, against the defendant Wang Guiping for the crimes of endangering public security by dangerous means, selling fake and shoddy products, and falsely reporting registered capital.

Charges in the Indictment:

I. The defendant Wang Guiping committed the crime of endangering public security by dangerous means.

In January 2005, the defendant Wang Guiping used forged business license, drug manufacturing license, and drug registration certificate of "China Geological Mining Corporation Taixing Chemical Plant" to gain the trust of Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. In September 2005, Niu Zhongren (already separately prosecuted for the crime of causing a major liability accident), a purchasing staff member of that company, ordered 1 ton of pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol from Wang Guiping at a price of RMB 14,500 per ton. Knowing that diethylene glycol cannot be used as a pharmaceutical ingredient, Wang Guiping purchased 1 ton of diethylene glycol from Zhangjiagang Free Trade Zone Huabang International Trade Co., Ltd. at a price of RMB 7,200 per ton, passed it off as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol, and under the name of "Jiangsu Meiqi Fine Chemical Co., Ltd.," shipped it to Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. through Changzhou Yutian Logistics Co., Ltd. on September 22, and mailed five forged product certificates with batch number 050919 to Niu Zhongren, who affixed them to the barrels.

In March 2006, Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. used the counterfeit pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol (batch number 050919) sold by the defendant Wang Guiping to produce Armillarisin A injection (specification: 10ml:5mg, batch number 06030501), which was sold in two batches on March 28 and April 21, 2006 to Guangzhou Hengyuanyuan Pharmaceutical Trading Co., Ltd., which sold all of the drugs to Guangdong Medical & Health Products Co., Ltd. Guangdong Medical & Health Products Co., Ltd. sold 3,600 ampoules of the said drug in three batches on April 7, 17, and 25, respectively, to the Third Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University, Guangdong Province. The hospital began clinical use on April 19, 2006, administering the drug to more than 60 patients, resulting in 15 patients developing acute renal failure or worsening of their conditions, including 14 patients such as Wu Mingyuan who died.

II. The defendant Wang Guiping committed the crime of selling fake and shoddy products.

Between January 2005 and April 2006, the defendant Wang Guiping passed off industrial-grade propylene glycol as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol, and passed off diethylene glycol as ethylene glycol or dipropylene glycol, and sold them to Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., Chongqing Shuangqiao Applied Chemical Co., Ltd., and Ningbo Qianqianxiu Daily Necessities Co., Ltd., with total sales amounting to RMB 297,310. Details are as follows:

1. In January 2005, the defendant Wang Guiping passed off 1 ton of industrial-grade propylene glycol as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol and sold it to Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., with sales of RMB 14,500;
2. In December 2005, the defendant Wang Guiping passed off 12.65 tons of diethylene glycol as ethylene glycol and sold it to Chongqing Shuangqiao Applied Chemical Co., Ltd., with sales of RMB 107,525;
3. In April 2006, the defendant Wang Guiping passed off 18.4 tons of diethylene glycol as ethylene glycol and sold it to Chongqing Shuangqiao Applied Chemical Co., Ltd., with sales of RMB 145,360;
4. In April 2006, the defendant Wang Guiping passed off 2.25 tons of diethylene glycol as dipropylene glycol and sold it to Ningbo Qianqianxiu Daily Necessities Co., Ltd., with sales of RMB 29,925.

III. The defendant Wang Guiping committed the crime of falsely reporting registered capital.

In October 2005, without actually paying the registered capital, the defendant Wang Guiping, through others, provided Zhang Zhongren of Nanjing Zhengyi United Accounting Firm with forged documents including cash payment slips for a total of RMB 5,000,000, bank statements, and bank confirmation letters, thereby obtaining a capital verification report. Thereafter, he obtained a business license for Jiangsu Meiqi Fine Chemical Co., Ltd., with a registered capital of RMB 5,000,000, from the Taixing City Administration for Industry and Commerce.

In summary, the defendant Wang Guiping, by the dangerous method of selling diethylene glycol passed off as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol to a pharmaceutical enterprise, caused the deaths of multiple persons. The circumstances were particularly egregious and the consequences were especially serious; in the course of selling products, he passed off counterfeits as genuine; and in the process of applying for company registration, he used false supporting documents to deceive the company registration authority, obtained company registration, and falsely reported a huge amount of registered capital. His conduct violated Article 115, paragraph 1, Article 140, and Article 158, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter "Criminal Law"), and he should be investigated for criminal liability for the crimes of endangering public security by dangerous means, selling fake and shoddy products, and falsely reporting registered capital. A request was made for the court to adjudicate according to law.

Defense of the Defendant Wang Guiping:

The defendant Wang Guiping argued: I have no objection to the nature and facts of the crimes of selling fake and shoddy products and falsely reporting registered capital as charged by the Procuratorial Authority. However, there is no factual basis for the charge of endangering public security by dangerous means. Prior to the incident, I was not aware that the diethylene glycol sold to Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. would be used as a pharmaceutical ingredient, nor was I aware that passing off diethylene glycol as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol to produce drugs would endanger the lives of multiple persons. I also knew that diethylene glycol is generally used only in chemical products and cannot be used as a pharmaceutical ingredient. To avoid problems, before selling, I personally drank a small amount of diethylene glycol and felt a slight burning pain in my stomach, but no other strong reactions. I thought there would be no problem in passing off diethylene glycol as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol, and therefore made the sale. Otherwise, I would never have sold diethylene glycol as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol. Therefore, my conduct does not constitute the crime of endangering public security by dangerous means, but only the crimes of selling fake and shoddy products and falsely reporting registered capital. I have also reported and exposed criminal clues of others. I request the court to give a lighter punishment according to law.

Facts Found by the Intermediate People's Court of Taizhou City at First Instance:

I. Facts concerning the defendant Wang Guiping's alleged crime of endangering public security by dangerous means.

In January 2005, the defendant Wang Guiping used forged business license, drug manufacturing license, and drug registration certificate of "China Geological Mining Corporation Taixing Chemical Plant" to gain the trust of Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., and the two parties entered into business dealings. In September 2005, Niu Zhongren (already separately prosecuted for the crime of causing a major liability accident), a purchasing staff member of Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., ordered 1 ton of pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol from the defendant at a price of RMB 14,500 per ton. For the purpose of obtaining profit, knowing that diethylene glycol cannot be used as a pharmaceutical ingredient, the defendant purchased 1 ton of diethylene glycol from Zhangjiagang Free Trade Zone Huabang International Trade Co., Ltd. at a price of RMB 7,200 per ton, passed it off as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol, and under the name of "Jiangsu Meiqi Fine Chemical Co., Ltd.," shipped it to Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. through Changzhou Yutian Logistics Co., Ltd. on September 22, and later mailed five forged product certificates with batch number 050919 to Niu Zhongren.

In March 2006, Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. tested the counterfeit pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol (batch number 050919) sold by the defendant Wang Guiping and found that its relative density was higher than normal. However, to meet production deadlines, it still improperly issued a passing test report and used the batch of propylene glycol in production, producing Armillarisin A injection (specification: 10ml:5mg, batch number 06030501). The injection was sold in two batches on March 28 and April 21, 2006 to Guangzhou Hengyuanyuan Pharmaceutical Trading Co., Ltd., which sold all of the drugs to Guangdong Medical & Health Products Co., Ltd. Guangdong Medical & Health Products Co., Ltd. sold the said drugs in three batches on April 7, 17, and 25, 2006, respectively, to the Third Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University, Guangdong Province, totaling 3,600 ampoules. The hospital began clinical use on April 18, 2006, administering the drug to more than 60 patients, resulting in 15 patients developing acute renal failure or worsening of their conditions, including 14 patients such as Wu Mingyuan who died. The Forensic Identification Center of Southern Medical University conducted an autopsy on patient Wu Mingyuan on June 8, 2006, and concluded: 1. Wu Mingyuan died of multiple organ failure; 2. Wu Mingyuan's toxic nephropathy and renal failure had a causal relationship with diethylene glycol poisoning; 3. Diethylene glycol poisoning could aggravate and promote Wu Mingyuan's liver necrosis and liver failure; 4. It could not be ruled out that diethylene glycol had toxic damage to the brain, spleen, testicles, and other organs.

II. Facts concerning the defendant Wang Guiping's alleged crime of selling fake and shoddy products.

Between January 2005 and April 2006, the defendant Wang Guiping passed off industrial-grade propylene glycol as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol, and passed off diethylene glycol as ethylene glycol or dipropylene glycol, and sold them to Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., Chongqing Shuangqiao Applied Chemical Co., Ltd., and Ningbo Qianqianxiu Daily Necessities Co., Ltd., with total sales amounting to RMB 297,310. Details are as follows:

1. In January 2005, the defendant Wang Guiping passed off 1 ton of industrial-grade propylene glycol as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol and sold it to Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., with sales of RMB 14,500;
2. In December 2005, the defendant Wang Guiping passed off 12.65 tons of diethylene glycol as ethylene glycol and sold it to Chongqing Shuangqiao Applied Chemical Co., Ltd., with sales of RMB 107,525;
3. In April 2006, the defendant Wang Guiping passed off 18.4 tons of diethylene glycol as ethylene glycol and sold it to Chongqing Shuangqiao Applied Chemical Co., Ltd., with sales of RMB 145,360;
4. In April 2006, the defendant Wang Guiping passed off 2.25 tons of diethylene glycol as dipropylene glycol and sold it to Ningbo Qianqianxiu Daily Necessities Co., Ltd., with sales of RMB 29,925.

III. Facts concerning the defendant Wang Guiping's alleged crime of falsely reporting registered capital.

In October 2005, without actually paying the registered capital, the defendant Wang Guiping, through others, provided Zhang Zhongren of Nanjing Zhengyi United Accounting Firm with forged documents including cash payment slips for a total of RMB 5,000,000, bank statements, and bank confirmation letters, thereby fraudulently obtaining a capital verification report. Thereafter, he obtained a business license for Jiangsu Meiqi Fine Chemical Co., Ltd., with a registered capital of RMB 5,000,000, from the Taixing City Administration for Industry and Commerce.

The above facts are confirmed by the confession of the defendant Wang Guiping, the testimony of over 70 witnesses including Zhou Dongjun, Wang Zhanjiang, and Hong Guolan, the "Explanation Concerning Issues Related to China Geological Mining Corporation Taixing Chemical Plant" issued by Jiangsu Provincial Food and Drug Administration, the certificates, submission-for-testing forms, sampling forms, test records, and excipient test reports issued by Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., the forged business license, drug manufacturing license, and drug registration certificate of "China Geological Mining Corporation Taixing Chemical Plant" and other qualification documents, the involved special VAT invoices, the purchase and sale contracts, warehouse receipts, delivery notes, and acceptance forms for purchased drugs provided by Guangdong Medical & Health Products Co., Ltd., the statistical table of patients using Armillarisin A injection and "Status of Deceased Patients in the Armillarisin A Incident" provided by the Third Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University, the test report of the National Institute for the Control of Pharmaceutical and Biological Products, the drug sampling records and certificates issued by Guangdong Provincial Food and Drug Administration, the test report and identification report of Armillarisin A injection samples issued by Guangdong Provincial Institute for Drug Control, the test report of Heilongjiang Provincial Institute for Drug Control, the identification conclusion of the Forensic Identification Center of Southern Medical University, the "Less-than-Truckload Inquiry Form" and "Receipt of Jiangdu Northeast Shipping Company," the forged propylene glycol test report sheet issued by Wang Guiping, the explanation issued by the Qiqihar City Food and Drug Administration Inspection Detachment, the test report numbered 2006C0208 issued by Jiangsu Provincial Institute for Drug Control, and the forged cash payment slips, bank statements, and bank confirmation letters issued by Wang Guiping. The evidence is sufficient for identification.

Reasoning of the Intermediate People's Court of Taizhou City at First Instance:

The defendant Wang Guiping sold diethylene glycol passed off as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol to a pharmaceutical enterprise, causing the drugs produced by that enterprise to cause the deaths of multiple persons after being put on the market. The circumstances were egregious and the consequences were serious. His conduct has constituted the crime of endangering public security by dangerous means. Although Wang Guiping argued that he was not aware whether the diethylene glycol would be used for drug production, nor whether it would cause harm to the human body after being made into drugs, based on the nature of his work, life experience, and his cognitive ability and level, given that the pharmaceutical enterprise ordered pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol, Wang Guiping should have known that the diethylene glycol he sold to the pharmaceutical enterprise would be used to produce drugs and ultimately for clinical treatment. Moreover, according to the facts found in this case, before actually selling, Wang Guiping personally drank a small amount of diethylene glycol, felt a slight burning pain in his stomach, but had no other strong reactions, and then proceeded to sell diethylene glycol as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol. Thus, Wang Guiping knew beforehand that diethylene glycol could not be used for drug production. Subjectively, he recognized that his conduct could cause harm to society, but allowed such consequences to occur, resulting in Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. using the counterfeit pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol to produce substandard Armillarisin A injection. Since the users of the injection were unspecified patients, and diethylene glycol poisoning causes enormous harm to the human body, Wang Guiping's conduct of selling diethylene glycol passed off as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol to the pharmaceutical company constitutes the crime of endangering public security by dangerous means, and he should be investigated for criminal liability according to law.

In the course of selling products, the defendant Wang Guiping passed off industrial-grade propylene glycol as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol and passed off diethylene glycol as ethylene glycol or dipropylene glycol, which constitutes passing off counterfeits as genuine. The sales amount exceeded RMB 200,000. His conduct has constituted the crime of selling fake and shoddy products. In the process of applying for company registration, the defendant Wang Guiping used false supporting documents to deceive the company registration authority, obtained company registration, and falsely reported a huge amount of registered capital. His conduct has constituted the crime of falsely reporting registered capital. Wang Guiping committed multiple crimes and should be subjected to cumulative punishment for multiple crimes according to law.

The defendant Wang Guiping claimed that after being brought to justice, he had reported and exposed criminal clues of others. However, according to the facts found in this case, the criminal clues of others reported and exposed by Wang Guiping were found to be untrue after investigation.

In summary, the facts charged by the Procuratorial Authority are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, and the legal characterization is accurate, and the charges should be supported according to law. Accordingly, the Intermediate People's Court of Taizhou City, in accordance with Article 115, paragraph 1, Article 140, Article 158, paragraph 1, Article 56, paragraph 1, Article 57, paragraph 1, Article 69, and Article 64 of the Criminal Law, rendered the following judgment on May 23, 2008:

1. The defendant Wang Guiping is sentenced to life imprisonment for the crime of endangering public security by dangerous means, with deprivation of political rights for life; sentenced to three years' imprisonment for the crime of selling fake and shoddy products, and fined RMB 300,000; sentenced to two years' imprisonment for the crime of falsely reporting registered capital, and fined RMB 100,000; the combined punishment is life imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for life, and a fine of RMB 400,000;
2. The illegal gains of the defendant Wang Guiping in the amount of RMB 297,310 are to be confiscated.

Wang Guiping refused to accept the first-instance judgment and appealed to the High People's Court of Jiangsu Province. His main grounds for appeal were: 1. The first-instance judgment's finding that the appellant Wang Guiping constituted the crime of endangering public security by dangerous means was improper; his conduct should be characterized as selling fake and shoddy products, or at most constitutes the crime of negligently endangering public security by dangerous means. Because the appellant was not aware that diethylene glycol would cause serious harm to the human body, he lacked the criminal intent to endanger public security by dangerous means. Furthermore, there was no causal relationship in criminal law between the appellant's conduct and the final serious consequences, because the factor of Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. producing and selling counterfeit drugs intervened, and that intervening factor played a decisive role in the occurrence of the consequences. 2. The first-instance judgment imposed an excessive sentence. For the facts of the crime of endangering public security by dangerous means found in the first-instance judgment, the appellant had truthfully confessed during the administrative authority's investigation before being subjected to compulsory measures, which should be considered voluntary surrender. Additionally, the facts of the crimes of selling fake and shoddy products and falsely reporting registered capital found in the first-instance judgment were voluntarily confessed by the appellant after being subjected to compulsory measures, constituting confession of crimes of a different nature, which should also be deemed voluntary surrender. After being brought to justice, the appellant had a good attitude of admitting guilt and actively cooperated with the judicial authorities in ascertaining the facts of the case, so he should be given a lighter or mitigated punishment.

The High People's Court of Jiangsu Province, upon trial, confirmed the facts found by the first-instance court.

Reasoning of the High People's Court of Jiangsu Province at Second Instance:

Regarding the appellant Wang Guiping's appeal ground that there was no causal relationship in criminal law between his conduct and the final serious consequences, and that the first-instance judgment's characterization of the crime of endangering public security by dangerous means was improper, according to the facts found in this case, the appellant not only knew that the purpose of the pharmaceutical enterprise ordering pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol was to produce drugs, but also knew that diethylene glycol cannot be used to process drugs, otherwise it would harm others' health. However, for the purpose of obtaining illegal profits, he allowed the harmful consequences to occur, thus possessing indirect criminal intent to endanger public security by dangerous means. In this case, Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. used the pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol that the appellant had falsified with diethylene glycol to produce drugs. Although the company did not conduct inspection in accordance with regulations during production, and its production conduct had a certain degree of independence, this does not negate the existence of a causal relationship between the appellant's conduct and the harmful consequences in this case. The appellant should bear criminal liability according to law. This ground of appeal of the appellant cannot be established and is not adopted.

Regarding the appellant Wang Guiping's appeal ground that he had the circumstance of voluntary surrender, had a good attitude of admitting guilt, and that the first-instance judgment imposed an excessive sentence, according to the facts found in this case, before the investigative authority's first interrogation of the appellant, it had already basically grasped the criminal facts that he had intentionally passed off diethylene glycol as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol and sold it to Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. Moreover, during the first interrogation, the appellant did not truthfully confess but concealed the criminal facts of selling diethylene glycol passed off as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol to Qiqihar Second Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. The criminal facts of the crimes of selling fake and shoddy products and falsely reporting registered capital found by the first-instance court were also the result of active investigation by the investigative authority. The appellant only confessed to the criminal facts under pressure after the investigative authority had grasped certain evidence and facts. Furthermore, the investigation record of the appellant by the Taizhou City Food and Drug Administration on May 12, 2005 shows that the appellant also concealed the main facts of selling diethylene glycol passed off as pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol during the administrative authority's investigation. Therefore, the appellant's claim that he had the circumstance of voluntary surrender cannot be established. In addition, although the appellant had a good attitude of admitting guilt after being brought to justice and actively cooperated with the judicial authorities in ascertaining the facts of the case, the consequences caused by his criminal conduct were serious. Therefore, the first-instance court's sentencing was not improper.

In summary, appellant Wang Guiping used a dangerous method by substituting diethylene glycol for pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol and selling it to pharmaceutical enterprises, resulting in the drugs produced by those enterprises, after being placed on the market, causing serious consequences in which 15 patients developed acute renal failure or had their conditions aggravated, and 14 of those patients died. His conduct constituted the crime of endangering public safety by dangerous means; by passing off inferior products as genuine ones, with the amount of counterfeit and substandard products sold exceeding 290,000 yuan, his conduct constituted the crime of selling counterfeit and substandard products; during the process of applying for company registration, by using false certifying documents to deceive the company registration authority and obtaining company registration, he falsely reported registered capital of 5 million yuan, a huge amount, and his conduct constituted the crime of falsely reporting registered capital. The appellant has committed multiple crimes and shall be subjected to concurrent punishment for multiple crimes according to law. The facts found by the court of first instance are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, the conviction is accurate, the sentence is appropriate, the application of law is correct, and the trial procedures are lawful, all of which should be affirmed. Accordingly, in accordance with the provisions of Article 189, Item (1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Jiangsu High People's Court ruled on August 28, 2008:

The appeal is dismissed and the original judgment is affirmed.

This ruling is final.
